company.name: NERIC
company.shortDescription: NERIC is a joint-venture company formed by a group of Egyptian companies in partnership with government to establish a rolling stock plant.

productsAndServices.description: A facility for producing electric rolling stock units including passenger cars, power cars, and freight cars for local and regional markets.
productsAndServices.name: Rolling Stock Manufacturing Plant

productsAndServices.description: A facility dedicated to the refurbishment and overhaul of existing electric rolling stock units to extend their service life.
productsAndServices.name: Rolling Stock Rehabilitation Plant

productsAndServices.description: A production facility for manufacturing high-speed train cars designed for long-distance and rapid transit rail services.
productsAndServices.name: High-Speed Train Car Manufacturing Plant

productsAndServices.description: Maintenance services for rolling stock units provided either at NERIC’s workshops or on-site at the client’s location.
productsAndServices.name: Maintenance Services

productsAndServices.description: Training programs designed to equip clients with the skills needed to maintain and manage rolling stock fleets effectively.
productsAndServices.name: Maintenance Training Programs
